// diagnostic

E0633

This `irreversible: fn` body is not an effect fact

What

This `irreversible: fn` body is not an effect fact

Why

The compiler reads `irreversible` without running it, so its body is `true`, `false`, `self == .Case` or an `||` of those, naming cases of `{family}`

Fix

Write `{ true }`, `{ false }` or `{ self == .Write }`

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0633: tests/ui/effects/effect_irreversible_body_is_not_a_fact.stderr.

Error [jet.IrreversibleNotAFact]: This `irreversible: fn` body is not an effect fact
  --> tests/ui/effects/effect_irreversible_body_is_not_a_fact.jet:6:42
    |
  6 |         irreversible: fn(self) -> Bool { self != .Read }
    |                                          ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: The compiler reads `irreversible` without running it, so its body is `true`, `false`, `self == .Case` or an `||` of those, naming cases of `Ledger`
 Fix: Write `{ true }`, `{ false }` or `{ self == .Write }`
